name: Studies of a stonemason, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: Four studies of a Chinese stonemason, sitting or crouching, shaded by a fabric sheet attached to a framework of poles; on the right two masons are seen on the wall at the foot of the Praya Grande, Macau

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
